name: The foul factory
engine: Yamal's lost runs become fouls, and each free kick is a menu of rehearsed routines.
about: Yamal goes looking for contact: fewer of his runs come off cleanly, but once a moment a lost run is a foul instead, a free kick at the edge of their box and a booking. A booked man cannot risk a tackle, so the next run at him rolls two dice. Every free kick at the edge of their box is rehearsed: Baena's quick free kick before their wall is set, or the near-post flick, with Laporte coming up to win it, as well as Baena's shot. Baena's own free kicks need only 3 for a clean win, and one that hits the wall comes back to him. Each routine they see is -2 next time, so you alternate. Captain Rodri lets Yamal's once-a-moment foul work once more each half.
